name: Xiaomi TV EA Pro 55-inch (L55MA-EP)
summary: Xiaomi TV EA Pro 55-inch (L55MA-EP) ships with telemetry, ads, shopping and cloud control. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with backup and undo.
intro: This China-market Xiaomi TV ships with telemetry and log upload, push, cloud control, ads and promoted content, shopping and payment, and cleaners and panels. It also has casting and smart-home parts. Each app has its own switch in the app, so you decide which ones to turn off.

It was used for a day with two reboots and several standby cycles, and nothing broke that is not noted here. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Xiaomi TV player for live TV and sources
The stock home, with a special build to replace it
notes: Only system apps or allowlisted names can become Home on this TV, so the standard new home screen leaves a black screen.
Network debugging closes at every boot. Turn it back on in Account and Security.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my Xiaomi TV EA Pro 55-inch?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: Can I use the clean home screen on this TV?
faq.a: Only a special build works. The standard one would leave a black screen if the Xiaomi home is switched off.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my Xiaomi TV EA Pro 55-inch?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
